items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Most business sites cost {price:websites.basic..websites.intermediate}; stores and custom builds more. The full ranges are above, and the guide {guideLink} walks through what moves the number.
Most business sites take 4 to 8 weeks from kickoff; stores and custom builds longer. The chat gives you a timeline with your quote.
items._todo_timeline: TODO(angelique): confirm the 4 to 8 weeks timeline (brief §5.7)

items.q: Does my Quebec website need to be in French?
items.a: If you do business in Quebec, yes: your site has to be available in French, at least as prominently as any other language (the Charter of the French Language, updated by Bill 96). We build in both languages by default, and the French is written, not machine-translated.

items.q: Is the price from the chat binding?
items.a: It's a range, not a final quote. Angelique confirms the exact amount after a short conversation, and it won't exceed the range you were shown.

items.q: Who owns the site when it's done?
items.a: You do — code, design, content and accounts in your name.
items._todo_ownership: TODO(angelique): confirm against the T&C wording (brief §5.7)

items.a: WordPress (with ACF or Elementor), Shopify, WooCommerce, or fully custom code when the project calls for it. We recommend the one that fits, not the one that pays us the most.
Run it yourself — we hand over with training — or put it on a maintenance plan (Light, Standard or Premium; ranges above).

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Quebec?
items.a: Yes, across Canada, in English or French.

privacy._todo_policy: TODO(angelique): confirm against monkeysat.work's policy and name the privacy officer Law 25 requires (brief §11)

paragraphs: When you send the form: your name, your email address and what you wrote. Nothing else.

If you accept analytics in the banner: which pages you visit, how you got here, your device and browser type and your approximate location, through Google Analytics 4. Until you accept, no analytics script loads and no cookie is set. If you decline, nothing is collected.
The quote chat runs on monkeysat.work, under that site's own privacy policy.
The form details are used to answer your question. Nothing else — no newsletter, no sharing, no selling.
Analytics tell us whether this site is useful and worth keeping up. That's it.
Form submissions go to HubSpot, the customer relationship tool Monkeys at Work uses, with a record of the consent you gave.
Analytics data goes to Google Analytics 4, with IP addresses anonymized.
Your analytics choice is remembered in your browser for 12 months. Form details are kept for as long as we need them to follow up with you, and deleted on request.
To see, correct or delete what we hold about you, email support@monkeysat.work. We'll confirm when it's done.
